description: KR4OGH PT-01, 20 m channel 206, raw wspr.live spots with every column, pulled 2026-11-03 for the cross-receiver pairing tier (docs/cross-receiver-pairing.md). Three windows: 2026-11-02 10:00 to 2026-11-03 10:00 (the last same-station fixes over Pakistan, then Tibet, where E28AC heard the Regular messages and UA9720SWL the telemetry); 2026-10-31 12:50-24:00 (PT01's sensor messages over the eastern Mediterranean with its Regular messages mostly unheard, then other balloons' 1?0 traffic overnight); 2026-11-01 11:20-13:00 (the GPS spoof over Iran). Plus every minute-:x4 spot of the flight, which belongs to another balloon. Expected output is the Python pipeline's, frozen; tests/test_infer.py checks the fixtures in it against values worked out by hand.
